text:
I traveled from the United States to Thailand for eyelid surgery and had an excellent experience. The doctor was extremely precise, professional, and had wonderful bedside manners. He took the time to explain everything clearly and made me feel comfortable throughout the process.

The entire staff was incredibly caring and attentive. As an international patient, I felt well taken care of from start to finish. They were always available to answer questions and followed up after surgery to check on my recovery.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone considering eyelid surgery, especially those traveling from abroad. The level of care and professionalism exceeded my expectations.
